# Setup
## Read in data

```{r load packages}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(readr)
library(here)
```

```{r read in data}
#| message: false
bg_chem <- read_csv(here('data','BGchem2008data.csv'))
```

```{r view data properties}
#| eval: false
#| echo: false
colnames(bg_chem)
str(bg_chem)
head(bg_chem)
summary(bg_chem)
```

# Analysis
## Summary statistics
```{r}
nitrate <- mean(bg_chem$NO3)
nitrite <- mean(bg_chem$NO2)
amm     <- mean(bg_chem$NH4)
phos    <- mean(bg_chem$P)
```

## Redfield Ratio
```{r}
ratio <- (nitrate + nitrite + amm) / phos
```
The Redfield ratio for this dataset is approximately `{r} round(ratio)`.

## Plot
```{r}
plot(bg_chem$P, bg_chem$NO2 + bg_chem$NO3 + bg_chem$NH4)
```
